page.overview:
Who is Candlewicke Greenthistle?

Matchwicke's cousin and every bit the criminal at heart, Candlewicke Greenthistle is friendly but quiet. Behind his innocent façade is the mind of a careful schemer and plotter. It was his idea to blackmail Haagen, and he helped Matchwicke come up with the plan to use adventurers to dig up dirt on the other two families.

Short, even by Halfling standards, he has a mop of unruly red hair and a freckled face. He typically wears an apron and is considered one of the best cooks in the Greenthistle clan. When he’s nervous he wiggles the pinkie on his left hand.
